heard: A magnetic monster at our galaxy's heart is whipping gas. Sagittarius A star is a black hole 4 million times heavier than the sun. Astronomers found it by watching stars screaming around an invisible point. They finally snapped its photo in 2022 using telescopes across Earth. That glowing ring hides magnetic fields that snap with violent force. These explosions launch gas clumps at 30% the speed of light. Astronomer Reinhard Genzel won the 2020 Nobel Prize for proving this anchor exists. It's the only thing keeping our galaxy's heart a magnetic monster.
